name: Sharon Kwan
office: City of Arcadia, Member of the City Council, 2nd District

items.text: Sharon Kwan is a District 2 council member. She was elected in 2022. She served as mayor until February 2026. Before office, she led the Rancho Santa Anita Property Owners Association and served on local boards. She is a small business owner.

sentences.text: Sharon Kwan is a District 2 council member.
She served as mayor until February 2026.
Before office, she led the Rancho Santa Anita Property Owners Association and served on local boards.
She is a small business owner.

items.text: Her campaign says she proposed discussing then-Mayor Wang's foreign connections before Wang's guilty plea. She urged the council to review members' ties to a China-linked media firm. She voted against the 2026-27 budget, calling it a deferral of costs. She opposed a drug rehab center and an 11% sales tax. The council censured her in 2025 for decorum violations; she claimed retaliation, but a court upheld the censure.
